notes: No colophon date or persons survive. Bendall says the title of the work and the date are illegible. He dates the various hands only on palaeographic grounds ("chiefly XVIIIth cent."), so no ce_approx is given. The section endings he quotes (Buddhagīta stotra, Vajramahākālastavastotra, Maṅgalānuvartana) name works, not people. "स्तोचं" is Bendall's printing of stotraṃ.
